The Qualified Thalmos Utopia
Thalmon's society is not canonically established as an objective utopia. Shortcomings, excluded groups, unintended consequences, and later criticism remain open.

The Echoes of the Imperial Children's Names
The names Aldren, Evandor, Minevra, Valerian, Oberon, Rhiannon, Merceran, and Wayland belong to the early Thalmos royal dynasty. Their historical or mythological echoes are not canonically literal derivations; Thalmon named his children before their later specialties were known, though later historians and storytellers associate their names with their fields.
